value.title: Prompt 01: legislation post-cutover programme controller and dependency manager
value.body:
Prompt 01 controller only for `conductor/tracks/legislation_post_cutover_state_and_publication_integrity_20260831`. Partial implementation: draft PR #289.

Register Prompts 02–21 with dependencies, explicit path ownership, acceptance evidence and external gates. Preserve runtime, canonical state, publication metadata and historical evidence. Code/capability migration, operational-state migration, corpus custody/recoverability and publication identity remain independent completion dimensions.

Current supplied scopes: Prompts 01–03. Prompt 02 is registered as #278 (merged PR #281, fixity and final-head checks verified, issue closed). Prompt 03 is registered as #284 (merged PR #287; verified local package, passing native assurance and all seven corrected-head hosted checks; issue closed).

Blocker: full texts of Prompts 04–21 are still required before their exact child scope registration, acceptance gates and unique defect ownership can be completed. The controller retains all supplied dependency edges but does not invent specialist scopes or issue IDs. Known unassigned findings include the Zenodo version/concept label discrepancy and additional standalone workflow diagnostics.

Acceptance: unique defect ownership, unambiguous active paths, machine-readable dependencies/gates and evidence-bound progress. Parent programme remains INCOMPLETE even when available controller checks and individual specialist PRs pass.

No publication, donor unarchive, DOI creation/mutation, secrets/settings changes or destructive action is authorized by this controller. Superseding current observations are in the PR and issue comments; historical receipts remain preserved.

value.title: Prompt 06: exact-inventory custody and revalidation lane
value.body:
## Scope and authorization

Implement user Prompt 06: a target-owned exact-inventory custody/revalidation lane, never generic search discovery. Owned paths: its workflow, source-set configuration, workflow tests and runbook. No Prompt 13 hosted proof, source execution, corpus publication, donor unarchive, secrets changes or unrelated workflow changes are authorized by this intake.

## Current dependency gate — INCOMPLETE / blocked

Live target main: `0a076fa26d2f4fcad9cac445e8c806d8c9e996d5`. Donor independently confirmed archived with final reachable main `b40587f1b1aec7356a0f623916fcc8212397d283`. No audited target SHA was supplied in Prompt 06.

- Prompt 05: passed through #299 / PR #304; stable seed ID `historical-work-ids-0001`, SHA-256 `59923176fa34796d7673a20b880af9abe5520fe484595edb220f2bbc0e3b33e7`.
- Prompt 08: no delivered/approved fail-closed parent-restore interface found. Required before source contact or workflow implementation.
- Prompts 11 and 12: no delivered/approved interfaces found. Exact scopes have not been provided here; ownership and contracts must not be guessed.

Evidence searched: current main's programme-status/handoff records, repository implementation paths, open PRs, issue searches, and controller #276 comments. The controller's committed Prompt 05 status is stale; live merged delivery takes precedence. No approved interface handoff for 08/11/12 was found. Parent #276 needs a superseding registration/handoff, not retrospective rewriting of older observations.

## Implementation acceptance checklist (pending prerequisites)

- Dedicated exact-inventory configuration/workflow; no search fallback.
- Fail-closed verified parent restore; explicit bootstrap authority only.
- Seed, artifact/state roots, every CAS object and lineage verified before source contact.
- Every one of the 500 IDs revalidated with explicit time/work/byte/retry/state limits.
- Explicit changed, unchanged-revalidated, unavailable, partial, failed and contract-permitted skipped outcomes.
- Exact identity, manifest/checkpoint and CAS reconciliation after acquisition.
- Agreed serialization interface covering every canonical-state mutator.
- Always-retained sanitized receipts and complete continuation package.
- Least privilege; only required source credentials; no publication secrets.
- Required negative/property/mutation/coverage tests, workflow policy and actionlint, native assurance and final-head hosted checks.

## Precise legacy hazards to resolve through prerequisite/agreed interfaces

At the recorded target SHA, `.github/workflows/scheduled-legislation-harvest.yml` creates empty state before restore, permits blank prior-state discovery and continuation when download fails, performs generic search acquisition and uses a workflow-specific concurrency group. Its job exposes unrelated publication credential variable names. It is not the approved Prompt 08 restore interface and must not be copied into the exact-inventory lane. These are code observations, not assertions about hosted execution. Discovery changes remain outside scope except shared-state conflict removal through an agreed interface.

No executable placeholder workflow, substitute prerequisite API or implementation PR will be created merely to bypass the dependency gate. The issue remains open; resume this same issue/branch after 08/11/12 pass or supply attributable approved interfaces.

value.title: Prompt 07: bounded discovery and freshness lane
value.body:
## Prompt 07 — bounded discovery and freshness only

Parent: #276. This issue owns the discovery/freshness workflow, source-set configuration, discovery receipts/schema/tests/runbook. It does not own the reviewed seed, exact-inventory lane (#308), durable-state implementation or publication metadata.

### Explicit prerequisite gate: blocked

At live target main `0a076fa26d2f4fcad9cac445e8c806d8c9e996d5`, no approved interface handoffs from Prompts 08, 11 or 12 were found in the repository's programme/handoff records, controller comments or open PRs. Their exact contracts must not be invented. The donor remains archived at final main `b40587f1b1aec7356a0f623916fcc8212397d283`. No audited target SHA was supplied in the prompt.

No executable workflow or replacement prerequisite interface is authorized by this intake. Implementation and a PR remain pending the approved handoffs. Preserve the existing generic search schedule without changing or executing it while this gate is unmet.

### Required outcome

- Visibly separate discovery/freshness from custody and exact-inventory revalidation.
- Explicit source endpoint identity, query semantics, sort/pagination rules, bounds and resumable strategy.
- Separate candidate counts, acquisition attempts, accepted canonical additions/changes and rejected/duplicate/unavailable/partial/failed outcomes; explicit no-change results.
- Every candidate passes identity, manifestation, payload, validation, rights and merge gates before canonical admission.
- Canonical changes use the approved state-merge contract, never direct shared manifest/checkpoint overwrites.
- Agreed serialization or partitioning prevents races with the exact-inventory lane.
- Deterministic pagination, query-drift, duplicate/malformed result, partial-source and concurrency tests; required critical/patch coverage, mutation and full assurance before delivery.
- Generic Act/Bill/Regulation searches never imply full coverage; discovery is not sole custody.

### Current-code observations, not hosted execution claims

`src/archive_govt_nz/domains/legislation/discovery.py::build_work_inventory` already emits `coverage_classification=search_derived_candidates` and `authoritative_completeness=False`; retain that distinction. It aggregates results and stops at the work bound, but its returned catalogue does not bind an explicit endpoint/query/sort/resume contract. Missing IDs and duplicates are skipped without separate rejection counts in this catalogue.

`tools/run_legislation_harvest.py::sync_legislation_records` passes canonical manifest/checkpoint paths into `LegislationArchiveService.sync_works`; `corpus.py` persists its resulting state. Existing lower-level integrity checks do not by themselves constitute approved interfaces for this new lane. `.github/workflows/scheduled-legislation-harvest.yml` has its own ref-scoped concurrency group; do not presume that serializes it against future canonical-state writers.

Reproduce these observations with `git show <recorded-target-sha>:<path>`. They are implementation integration work to resolve after prerequisite approval, not authorization to alter durable-state code or #308.

Status: **INCOMPLETE — prerequisite-blocked intake**. No source requests, workflow dispatches, scheduling changes, corpus publication, DOI or donor/product changes.

value.body:

Link continuation receipts to the verified parent and provide the narrow interface for 06/07.

Owned: restoration tool/library, schemas/tests, workflow helper/restoration wiring and contract documentation. No source-discovery semantics, donor/target merge, durable destination selection, publication policy, secrets/settings or recovery-drill execution.

Acceptance: every restoration consumer stops before acquisition on failure; explicit bootstrap; cryptographic parent lineage; no silent partial/empty continuation. Require focused/property/tamper/archive-bomb/stale/mutation tests, 100% critical coverage under repository policy, native assurance/security/workflow lint/actionlint and final-head hosted checks before merge.
